thread:
Alex Kim: quick sync — we need to lock scoring weights + golden-set composition for the NovaHealth POC. high level: define acceptance gates, decide goldens buckets, and call out SLA / pricing tradeoffs. who can take which piece?

Priya Menon: i can own acceptance gates + sec questionnaire answers. key asks from customer: no retention of PHI, SSO/SAML, and KMS. also they want audit logs for inference requests.

Samir Patel: for goldens composition i propose a 150-sample set: 60 core flows (billing/patient-match), 40 edge cases (misspellings, legacy ids), 30 adversarial (prompt injection/PII exfil), 20 formatting/templating checks. keeps balance between biz-critical and robustness.

Jordan Lee: scoring suggestion (simple, explainable):
```
final_score = 0.5 * semantic_score + 0.25 * exact_match + 0.15 * safety_score + 0.10 * latency_penalty
```
semantic_score uses human-rated 0-5 then normalized. safety_score is 0-1 where 1 = no safety hits. latency_penalty = max(0, (p95_ms - 200) / 1000).

Marta Ruiz: customer will aggressively test availability. they asked about SLA vs cost: they prefer guaranteed p99 < 300ms but can accept higher latency if unit-cost drops 30%. we should propose two packages: "SLA-priority" on Dedicated + higher price, and "Cost-priority" on Hosted with quantized fallback.

Alex Kim: important — tie acceptance to concrete thresholds so sales/legal can sign off. proposed acceptance criteria:
- final_score >= 0.78 on goldens (after weighting)
- false_positive_rate on admin alerts < 5%
- no safety-critical regressions across adversarial set
- p95 latency <= 250ms on dedicated env
- cost per 1k tokens below target tier (TBD)

Priya Menon: regression gate rules: run nightly smoke + full golden run on every canary deploy. block rollout if final_score drops by >3 points OR if any safety_score drops to 0 for >2 samples. also capture request/response to S3 for repro (obfuscated PHI).

Samir Patel: ops notes: need token-level cost tags and a billing measurement in harness. for canary plan: 10% traffic -> 25% after 24h if no issues -> 100% after 72h. add automatic fallback to smaller model if error rate > 2% for 10m.

Jordan Lee: i'll draft the goldens spreadsheet template with columns: id, flow_type, prompt, expected_output, rubric_notes, priority, sensitive_flag, reproduction_steps. link: https://redwood.example.co/goldens/template (placeholder). will share by EOD.

Marta Ruiz: pricing quick Q — do we include a "safety engineering" fee for adversarial hardening work? customer expects one-off integration effort.

Alex Kim: yes include one-off setup + monthly dedicated capacity. we should show cost delta for quantized vs full fp16 endpoints. @Samir can you pull a ballpark?

Samir Patel: ballpark: Dedicated SLA-priority ~ $12k/mo for target throughput; Hosted Cost-priority ~ $4.5k/mo + expected extra token spend. one-off safety hardening ~ 2-3 engineer-weeks. i'll add these to the quote draft.

Priya Menon: security checklist items to answer this week: data retention policy, KMS integration doc, SOC2/ISO artifacts, SSO approach, VPC peering options. i'll start draft answers and tag legal.

DeployBot: reminder: add canary pipeline in CI with nightly golden-run job. created ticket INF-4821.

Alex Kim: next steps/owners: Jordan -> goldens template + initial 150 list (EOD); Priya -> security Qs + regression gate doc (tomorrow); Samir -> cost estimates + canary config (tomorrow); Marta -> customer packaging/pricing ask (tomorrow). i'll consolidate and run presales call Thursday 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: ack, will push initial sheet and add sample prompts.

Marta Ruiz: will prep customer facing comparison doc and value props for SLA vs cost lanes.

Priya Menon: tagging legal and security for review, will ping once draft ready.

Alex Kim: thanks team — if anyone finds missing acceptance metrics call it out here, otherwise i'll prep the presales slide with these gates.

Samir Patel: one more ops note — include p50/p95/p99 cost buckets in reporting. prefer to start with p95 and iterate.

Marta Ruiz: got it. see you on Thu. :rocket:
